verdict.rationale: Foreloop's CLI is described as runnable 'from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron' (foreloop-docs-16), implying recurring jobs could be set up via external cron rather than a native scheduler; agents also poll for tasks 'on a cadence' (foreloop-docs-37). There is no first-party recurring-workflow or scheduling feature (no cron UI, no schedule config, no recurring trigger API) — missing for 10: native scheduling/automation engine, UI for managing recurring jobs, documentation of schedule intervals or triggers.
